instruction: Display all men's large-size short-sleeve shirts with a discount of 30% or more.

metadata.explanation: Variation 7: Changed discount from 50% to 30%, keeps L size and short-sleeve. Maintains same complexity and interaction pattern as original task.

llm_judge_reasons: Critical logic bug in getter function get_macys_product_url_parse (chrome.py:2550-2554): hardcoded to only recognize 50% discount
Getter returns 'not_50_PERCENT_ off & more' for ANY discount that is not exactly 50%, including the required 30% discount
Expected value is 'Price_discount_range': '30_PERCENT_ off & more', but getter will NEVER extract this value - it only returns '50_PERCENT_ off & more' or 'not_50_PERCENT_ off & more'
This causes systematic evaluation failure - even if user correctly completes the task (displays 30% off items), the evaluator will fail because getter cannot extract the actual discount value
Getter logic needs to be fixed to extract the actual discount percentage from URL rather than hardcoding 50% check
Other requirements (mens_clothing, shirts, size L, short_sleeve) can be verified correctly
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Fix get_macys_product_url_parse to extract actual Price_discount_range value from URL instead of hardcoding 50% check
The logic at chrome.py:2550-2554 should return the actual extracted value from key_value_json[key] rather than converting everything to '50_PERCENT_' or 'not_50_PERCENT_'
Example fix: Simply use 'result[key] = key_value_json[key]' to preserve the actual discount value from the URL
Alternatively, if special handling is needed for discount ranges, implement proper parsing that can handle 20%, 30%, 40%, 50%, etc. discount values
